palette.role: Evergreen cover, autumn nectar and winter berries, only where attachment, inspection and spread can be controlled.

attachment.supportNeeds: A replaceable, inspectable textured substrate of its own. It must not be allowed to enter gaps in timber.

monthsUK.basis: Months read from the RHS season wording (spring = Mar-May, summer = Jun-Aug, autumn = Sep-Nov, winter = Dec-Feb; early, mid and late are the first, second and third month).

flowering.display: Nectar-rich greenish flowers on adult shoots, then black berries in winter.

site.aspect: Shade to sun; exposed or sheltered.
site.soil: Broadly tolerant; fertile and well-drained preferred.

management.notes: Hold it to explicit boundaries; cut back and remove encroachment periodically; keep every timber junction exposed for inspection.

hazards: Stems can enter gaps in wooden structures, thicken and push sections apart (RHS, ivy on buildings).

sources.label: RHS: ivy on buildings and fences
